subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should Settings > Privacy replace the standalone Location-derived Privacy summary and segmented Location picker with the single Location card direction from the linked PR, provided it preserves an explicit Always access-level path?
rationale: The duplicate card state is source-proven, but changing the iOS control model and preserving background-location semantics needs owner-approved UX direction before the linked PR can land.

options.title: Approve the single-card direction
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR after it restores an explicit Always selection path, syncs native i18n, and keeps focused tests for the new contract.

options.title: Keep the current selector for now
options.body: Leave this issue open as product backlog and reject or narrow the linked PR until maintainers choose a different Location UI shape.

options.title: Defer to broader location posture work
options.body: Move the UX decision into the broader Always/background-location discussion and keep this issue blocked on that owner decision.

recommendation.title: Approve the single-card direction
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR after it restores an explicit Always selection path, syncs native i18n, and keeps focused tests for the new contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent same-destination iOS Settings ownership and current blame make this the best available owner for the UX direction.
